scoring_justification: The output contract does not include raw kinetic energy vs. m data, so we cannot recompute Tc from first principles; we compare the agent's Tc(c) values to the paper-reported reference curve using tolerances and structural checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Tc(c) curve: analytic function 1200*sin(πc/2) K.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 2; reported peak around 1200 K at c≈1, zero at c=0 and c=2, monotonic between.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived by fitting a sine envelope to the paper's description and figure scale.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Matches the paper's reported shape and peak magnitude for the base parameter set.

outputs.description: Tc(c) data from the base mean-field model, to be compared against the paper-reported curve for the same parameters.

output_contract.notes: Only the base mean-field model (dispersive Mo bands, no Hubbard U) is scored. The effective Heisenberg couplings and Hubbard-U results are excluded from this task per scope.
